newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian bonds seen tracking, not gaining on Bunds.
newsitem.headline: Belgian bonds seen tracking, not gaining on Bunds.

text.p: Belgian linear bonds were seen continuing to track Bunds through Wednesday despite new supply in the German market.

Dealers said a buoyant market meant 10-year German paper due to be auctioned later would easily be soaked up and other core Europe markets, including Belgium, would have a hard job capitalising while monetary union doubts, sparked by France's early election call, remain.
Around midday, the benchmark 10-year OLO yield was 5.96 percent, down from 5.99 percent in late Tuesday trade, but with the spread over Bunds flat to wider at 14 basis points.
